messages:
ci-bot: nightly alert: throughput -18% vs baseline for model rw-dense-v2 (us-west-2). metric: tokens/s down from 32k -> 26k around 02:13 UTC. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/nightly/2750011223 :warning: #NIGHTLY-4827
sara (runtime): saw it, thanks. pinging @jun oncall and @max for profiling. any obvious suspects?
jun (oncall): on it. do we have the failing commit range for the nightly run?
ci-bot: nightly run used image: release/v1.42@sha:6a4f2b9e (rolled at 2026-03-17T23:45:00Z)
max (profiling): quick perf smoke locally vs sha:6a4f2b9e -> baseline sha:6a4f21a. repro script: `tools/perf/simulate_load --model rw-dense-v2 --qps 80 --seq 96`
max (profiling): profiling snapshot (hot funcs, wall %):
```
KernelSelector::score_batch - 34.7%
KVCache::evict_if_needed - 18.2%
StreamExecutor::submit - 12.5%
AsyncIO::poll - 8.9%
other - 25.7%
```
max (profiling): interestingly kernel selection now prefers `kernel-light` for seq<=128 in many traces; increased kv evictions per-request (~+30%) and more small IOs -> higher tail.
kevin (infra): infra metrics show host mem pressure spike on g4dn-nightly-2 pool at same window, a few OOM-kills on background sidecars but not user containers. eviction spikes could amplify KV churn.
jun (oncall): starting a quick bisect across PRs landed in the window (release/v1.42). suspect PR #1482 from yesterday modifies adaptive kernel-weighting logic.
olga (releases): confirmed PR #1482 merged 2026-03-17T22:10 by @morgan. that changes selector weights and default thresh. CI perf job for main did not run the nightly perf-suite due to flaky harness flag (tracked in PERF-312).
sara (runtime): can someone try a local revert of the selector change and run the smoke? if that restores tokens/s we can roll back quickly.
max (profiling): did that: reverted the two lines in kernel_selector.cc that adjust weight delta. rerun: tokens/s back to 31.8k (baseline 32k), KV evictions back to baseline. regression reproduced -> blamed on adaptive weight change.
jun (oncall): bisect result: PR #1482 is root cause. creating issue and tagging for revert.
olga (releases): rolling revert via canary rollback. starting with 3 hosts (canary) then scale to 40.
deploy-bot: rollback job started: job_id rb-2750011223-1. canary deployed to 3/40 hosts. health checks ongoing.
kevin (infra): monitoring host pressure; will cordon any nodes with noisy background loads.
sara (runtime): nice catch. once rollback finishes we should run the full nightly perf-suite and keep perf-ci gated until regression test is added.
max (profiling): adding a focused perf test for kernel weight permutations to perf-suite (PR incoming). also adding a lightweight KV eviction assertion to the smoke harness.
jun (oncall): marking incident as triaged. thanks all. follow-up: postmortem and changelog note.
olga (releases): rollback succeeded on canary, promoting to full fleet now. deploy-bot: rollback complete, all hosts at release/v1.42@sha:6a4f21a. SLOs recovering (+0.5% within 10m). :thumbsup:
sara (runtime): great. open action items: 1) add perf regression test to CI (max), 2) add perf-gate to release pipeline for nightly-affecting changes (olga), 3) add KV eviction metric alert (jun/kevin). I'll own the postmortem draft.
max (profiling): PR for perf test posted: https://git.redwood/p/perf/pulls/279 - requests review.
jun (oncall): adding KV eviction alert to pager config now.
sara (runtime): closing thread once postmortem is up. thanks everyone!
